# Krishna Profile

> Krishna Profile is an Indian ISO-certified manufacturer specializing in Octagonal Steel Poles, Swaged Tubular Steel Poles, High Mast Lighting Towers, V-Cross Arm Sets, Guy Sets, GI Pins, and Transmission Line Hardware.

## Entity Overview
- **Legal Name**: Krishna Profile
- **Industry**: Electrical Pole Manufacturing, Structural Steel Fabrication, Power Transmission Hardware
- **Founding Year**: 2021
- **Location**: Sihor, Bhavnagar, Gujarat - 364240, India
- **Coordinates**: Lat 21.731875, Long 71.970605
- **Phone**: +91-9879917998
- **Email**: krishnaprofile20@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://krishnaprofile.com

## Key Products & Specifications

### 1. Octagonal Steel Poles
- **Design**: Continuous tapered 8-sided polygon design
- **Height**: 3 meters to 14 meters single section
- **Material**: High tensile steel plate (IS 2062 Grade E250/E350)
- **Finish**: Hot-Dip Galvanized as per IS 4759 / BS EN ISO 1461
- **Applications**: Highway lighting, urban street lights, solar lighting, smart city infrastructure

### 2. Swaged Tubular Steel Poles
- **Specification**: Manufactured in strict compliance with IS 2713 (Parts 1-3)
- **Types**: Single tube, 2-section swaged, 3-section swaged
- **Applications**: 11kV / 33kV overhead power distribution lines, telecom lines, rural electrification

### 3. High Mast Lighting Towers
- **Height Range**: 12 meters to 30+ meters
- **System**: Motorized/manual winch lantern carriage mechanism with safety locking system
- **Applications**: Stadiums, airport aprons, highway interchanges, sea ports, industrial yards

### 4. V-Cross Arm Sets & Guy Sets
- **V-Cross Arm**: Heavy-duty structural channel/angle fabrication hot-dip galvanized for 11kV & 33kV line support
- **Guy Set Assembly**: Complete stay wire, turnbuckle, stay rod, and stay plate assembly for pole stability

## Manufacturing Capabilities
- Hydraulic Press Brake bending up to 14m length
- Submerged Arc Welding (SAW) & MIG welding
- In-house testing laboratory for tensile, bend, and galvanization coating thickness checks
- Compliance Standards: IS 2713, IS 2062, IS 4759, IS 875 (Wind Loads)
